rationale: No candidate supplies a concrete, material drafting template for the postmaster regulation amendment. C02 and C20 share the closing formula that an order supersedes an earlier directive and identifies its title, but that is routine administrative language and their substantive regulatory machinery is unrelated. C04 has a somewhat similar recital structure concerning an existing directive and a changed factual condition, but it addresses extension of an emergency suspension and does not parallel the child's specific amendment of an eligibility threshold. These similarities are insufficient beyond boilerplate and generic amendment practice.

shared_material.child_excerpt: This order supersedes [DIRECTIVE_REFERENCE] of August 14, 1946, entitled "Amendment of the Regulations Governing the Appointment of Postmasters of the Fourth Class."
shared_material.parent_excerpt: This order supersedes [DIRECTIVE_REFERENCE] of June 8, 1944, entitled "Regulations Governing the Allowance of Travel Expenses of Claimants and Beneficiaries of the Veterans' Administration and of Their Attendants."
shared_material.explanation: C02 uses the same routine supersession-and-title closing formula, but its operative travel-expense provisions do not resemble the child's postmaster threshold amendment.
